scientific_integrity: A complete self-contained finite-parameter proof is included. Exhaustive exact-rational checks for 3 through 6 vertices are corroboration rather than proof of all sizes. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent fair edge orientations only; no full conditional distribution or asymptotic normality is asserted. Historical implicit coverage via older score-sequence analyses remains possible.
title: Sharp one-score prediction and orthogonal cycle fluctuations in random tournaments
